properties.name: resolution
properties.description: Quality multiplier on the device pixels the artboard covers on screen. 1 rasterizes one texel per device pixel, so compositing is a 1:1 blit; 2 is a genuine 2x supersample of what the screen shows. The raster is sized from the scale the artboard is actually viewed at (viewport zoom, display density and any mount scale, quantized to sixteenths), so it is re-rasterized when that scale changes, and it is capped at 2048 pixels per side.

properties.name: cacheFlags
properties.description: Bitmask holding the cache's boolean options: bit 0 cacheEnabled, bit 1 dither. The bits are exposed individually as passthrough properties so each can be keyed and data bound on its own.

properties.name: cacheEnabled
properties.description: Whether the artboard rasterizes to a cached bitmap at all. When off the artboard draws its vector content directly, as though it had no BitmapCache, and the cached texture is released.

properties.name: dither
properties.description: Whether the cached raster is dithered when it is rasterized. Content baked into the cache is dithered again when the raster composites, so turning this off avoids dithering the same pixels twice. RESERVED: not honored yet -- the offscreen frame uses the backend's default ditherMode regardless of this bit. Honoring it needs a dither mode carried on the canvas-content bracket so every host (immediate, deferred, serialized) rasterizes the same way.
